extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology update from paper-local XML/PDF locators; no unsupported figure quantification was fabricated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD spectra support a structural-context claim that QUB-1641 and analogues adopt alpha-helical structure in a membrane-mimicking 50% TFE/NH4Ac environment, while remaining random coil in aqueous NH4Ac.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural-context evidence; not by itself a direct antimicrobial mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SYTOX green membrane permeability assay directly supports membrane permeabilization against Staphylococcus aureus, with QUB-1570 and QUB-1609 reported as the strongest permeabilizers.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: QUB-1641 and analogues against Staphylococcus aureus NCTC 10788
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level exact percentages are not tabulated for every peptide/concentration in local text.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill kinetics support rapid bactericidal activity against Staphylococcus aureus for active analogues; QUB-1570 at 2x MIC is reported to clear S. aureus within 10 min.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: active QUB-1641 analogues against Staphylococcus aureus NCTC 10788
mechanism_claims.limitations: Functional killing kinetics; mechanism interpretation remains bounded by membrane-permeability evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Crystal-violet biofilm assays support anti-biofilm activity, strongest for QUB-1570 in Table 4, but this is treated as a functional phenotype rather than a molecular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: QUB-1641 and analogues against Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli biofilms
mechanism_claims.limitations: No quorum-sensing or molecular biofilm pathway mechanism is claimed.
